summary: BUG-538 E2E test on e1c7f05f deployment. Cashier login now works. CPP opened correctly via Order Entry → Collect Bill. FAIL: discount-section IS PRESENT for cashier even though roleBaseDiscount=Yes is set on backend. Root cause identified: profileTransform.js settings() function is missing `roleBaseDiscount` field, so restaurantSettings.roleBaseDiscount is always undefined in CPP → discountAllowed = !undefined || canDiscount = true → discount always shown.

ui_bugs.issue: discount-section IS visible to cashier (role without discount permission) even when roleBaseDiscount=Yes. Root cause: profileTransform.js settings() function does NOT include `roleBaseDiscount` field, so restaurantSettings.roleBaseDiscount is always undefined in CPP. The CPP fix code (L89) is correct but never activates because the gate value is never set.

action_items: Fix: Add `roleBaseDiscount: toBoolean(apiSettings.settings?.role_base_discount ?? apiSettings.role_base_discount)` to the `settings` function in /app/frontend/src/api/transforms/profileTransform.js (around line 423, before closing brace). This will make restaurantSettings.roleBaseDiscount=true for kunafamahal, activating the BUG-538 gate in CPP.
After fix: Re-test cashier CPP — discount-section should be ABSENT. Owner CPP — discount-section present + Apply button visible.
critical_code_review_comments: profileTransform.js settings() (L341-424): Missing `roleBaseDiscount: toBoolean(apiSettings.settings?.role_base_discount ?? apiSettings.role_base_discount)`. All other settings fields that live in `restaurants[0].settings.*` use the dual-path pattern (settings-nested first, root fallback). Same fix needed here.

CollectPaymentPanel.jsx L89-90: Code logic is correct. discountAllowed = !restaurantSettings?.roleBaseDiscount || canDiscount. showApplyButton = !!roleBaseDiscount && canDiscount && !!orderId. These are sound — just gated on the missing transform field.
Note: Apply button is NOT present for cashier (correct), NOT present for owner either (owner CPP not tested yet, but showApplyButton requires roleBaseDiscount=true which is also never set)
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL BUG FOUND: profileTransform.js settings() function is missing roleBaseDiscount field. Fix: add `roleBaseDiscount: toBoolean(apiSettings.settings?.role_base_discount ?? apiSettings.role_base_discount)` to the return object in profileTransform.js settings() function. After fix, test: (1) cashier CPP - discount-section absent, (2) owner CPP - discount-section present + Apply button visible. Cashier login NOW works with Qplazm@10. Navigation: click card text (e.g. 'Sachu') to open OrderEntry, then click 'Collect Bill' button at bottom right.
rca_of_issue: BUG-538 fix in CollectPaymentPanel.jsx (L89) is correct but ineffective because the gate value `restaurantSettings.roleBaseDiscount` is always undefined. The profile API returns `role_base_discount: 'Yes'` for kunafamahal in `restaurants[0].settings.role_base_discount`, but profileTransform.js settings() function (L341-424) never maps this field to the `roleBaseDiscount` camelCase key. Therefore CPP always sees `restaurantSettings.roleBaseDiscount = undefined`, making `discountAllowed = !undefined || false = true` for ALL users regardless of role. Fix: add the missing mapping to profileTransform.js.
